GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF ENGAGEMENT

1. Scope of Engagement

The Client appoints the Attorney to provide legal advice and/or representation in connection with the agreed matter. The Attorney will act in the Client’s best interests and in accordance with applicable professional standards.

2. Fees and Expenses

Fees are charged as follows:

  • Junior Lawyer: €120/hour

  • Senior Lawyer: €200/hour

  • Administrative work: €80/hour

  • Travel time: €80/hour

A retainer of €[amount] is payable upon signature and will be deducted from future invoices.

3. Responsibilities

The Attorney will maintain professional confidentiality, keep the Client informed of relevant developments, provide appropriate legal expertise, and avoid conflicts of interest.

The Client will provide accurate and complete information, cooperate with the Attorney, pay invoices when due, and communicate any relevant changes.

4. Documents and Data

Case files will be retained for 5 years after the end of the engagement unless otherwise agreed. Personal data will be processed in accordance with the GDPR and the firm’s privacy policy.

5. Termination

Either party may terminate the engagement with 15 days’ written notice. All fees and expenses incurred up to the termination date remain payable.

6. Liability

The Attorney maintains professional liability insurance with [insurance company].

7. Governing Law and Disputes

This agreement is governed by Belgian law. The parties will first seek to resolve disputes through mediation. If no agreement can be reached, the courts of [city] will have jurisdiction.

CORPORATE COUNSEL ENGAGEMENT TERMS

1. Scope of Services

The Firm will provide ongoing corporate legal support to the Client, including advice on commercial matters, contracts, corporate governance, compliance, and other agreed legal matters.

2. Fees

Services are billed at the following rates:

  • Junior Lawyer: €120/hour

  • Senior Lawyer: €200/hour

  • Administrative work: €80/hour

  • Travel time: €80/hour

Where applicable, specific matters may be subject to a fixed fee or separate fee arrangement agreed in advance.

3. Client Instructions

The Firm may act on instructions from the Client’s authorized representatives. The Client will provide all information and documentation reasonably required for the Firm to perform its services.

4. Confidentiality & Conflicts

All information received in connection with the engagement will be treated as confidential in accordance with applicable professional rules.

The Firm will carry out appropriate conflict-of-interest checks and will inform the Client if a potential conflict arises.

5. Documents and Data

Engagement files will be retained for 5 years following completion of the relevant matter. Personal data will be processed in accordance with the GDPR and the Firm’s privacy policy.

6. Termination

Either party may terminate the engagement with 15 days’ written notice. Fees and expenses incurred before termination remain payable.

7. Governing Law

The engagement is governed by Belgian law. Any unresolved dispute will fall under the jurisdiction of the courts of Brussels
